name: qida-devkit-ai
description: Internal marketplace of Claude Code plugins for Qida app development

plugins.name: qida-dev
plugins.description: Core development conventions and commands for Qida apps

plugins.name: qida-base
plugins.description: QidaBase local-dev commands: faker dev stack and ScreeningCall DB operations

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Protects main/master/develop branches: blocks Claude from pushing to them and installs a reusable git pre-push hook for manual pushes

plugins.name: docker
plugins.description: Docker containerization expertise: Dockerfile optimization, security hardening, multi-stage builds, Compose orchestration, and production deployment patterns

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Pull-request reviewer agents for Qida apps: deterministic magic-string detection for TypeScript/JavaScript (inline domain values, inline query keys per ADR-FE-002, literal UI text per ADR-FE-004, hardcoded secrets) TypeScript conventions for new code (no any or classes per ADR-FE-001, no enums, named exports, import type, plus advisory style rules) and Zod validation (safeParse, never parse)
